title: xrp-ledger.toml File
key_points: The xrp-ledger.toml file is a configuration file for the XRP Ledger.
It contains configuration options for the XRP Ledger, such as the path to the directory where the ledger data files will be stored.
The file also specifies the location of the transaction directory and the path to the SSL certificate and key files.
Updating this file is necessary when making changes to the XRP Ledger configuration.
limitations: The documentation assumes a basic understanding of the XRP Ledger and its components.
It does not cover all possible configurations or scenarios for the XRP Ledger.
asserts: The xrp-ledger.toml file is a crucial configuration file that determines how the XRP Ledger operates, specifying paths to data files and certificates.
scope: Describing the structure and purpose of the xrp-ledger.toml configuration file in the context of running an XRP Ledger instance.
